about: The values the vault method allows for note properties, in display order. The linter reads this file; so does zenvault_values, for filters that label and order them.

values.label: Primitive
values.description: A concept, principle, model or formula.

values.label: Hub
values.description: A map of one subject or context type.

values.label: Source
values.description: A book, article, video or news item and what is worth keeping.

values.label: Fact
values.description: Something true about the world, as of a date.

values.label: Decision
values.description: An agreement: what, why, the date, who decided.

values.label: Idea
values.description: Someone's idea, kept in their own words.

values.label: Stale
values.description: The body says what changed and as of when.

values.label: Project note
values.description: A document of a project, in its notes/ folder.
